item.title: [Gem State Chronicle] Rest in Peace Rick Hogaboam (3m)
item.description:
The article reflects on the sudden passing of Nampa Mayor Rick Hogaboam, who collapsed during a meeting and could not be revived despite efforts to save him. His death is a significant loss for the community and the state of Idaho, as he was seen as a promising leader with a deep understanding of civic issues and a strong commitment to his faith. The author emphasizes the importance of valuing life and prioritizing what truly matters, using Hogaboam's legacy as an example for public servants and citizens alike.

item.title: Untitled Episode (2m)
item.description:
The Idaho budget committee has introduced a new health and human services budget that includes an additional $21 million in cuts to Medicaid disability services, replacing a previously rejected budget. This reduction will not only impact essential services but also result in the loss of $44 million in federal funding, totaling a $65 million shortfall. These cuts are part of a broader trend of budget reductions pushed by Idaho Republicans and the governor throughout the 2026 legislative session, raising concerns about the implications for vulnerable populations reliant on these services.
